name: Nights at the Bastion
source:
The Bastion Café is a peculiar place where not every person you come across is an actual "person". Run by the enigmatic Dominique, watch as humans of all kinds seek out her and her supposed friends's aid while she attempts to figure out what makes them tick.

[Edited from [url=https://asterisksgames.itch.io/nights-at-the-bastion]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
堡垒咖啡馆是一个奇特的地方，并非你遇到的每个人都是真正的“人”。由神秘的多米尼克领导，看着各种各样的人类寻求她和她所谓的朋友的帮助，而她试图找出他们的动力。

[编辑自[url=https://asterisksgames.itch.io/nights-at-the-bastion]itch.io[/url]]
